scripts.firstDeps: npm run clean && npm install fs-extra --silent
scripts.il: npm run preClean && npm install --legacy-peer-deps && npm i pixi-webfont-loader --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run server
scripts.buildWithUpdate: npm run firstDeps && npm run update:local && python ./assetsBuild.py && npm run dev && npm run server
scripts.buildWithCoreExport: npm run firstDeps && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./updateMyCore.ps1 false && npm run update:local && python ./assetsBuild.py && npm run dev && npm run server
scripts.buildWithCoreExportIl: npm run firstDeps && npm run il && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./updateMyCore.ps1 true && npm run update:local && python ./assetsBuild.py && npm run dev && npm run server
scripts.exportAndDev: rimraf ./dev_bin && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./updateMyCore.ps1 false && npm run update:local && npm run dev
scripts.buildWithUpdateBB: npm run clean && python3 ./assetsBuild.py && npm run prod
